summary: Bitterroot NF summit lookout in Idaho County: a 1918 tent camp, a log cupola cabin, destroyed in 1950. No source describes the summit today.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in; the Selway-Bitterroot photo record places the peak in the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A University of Idaho photo dated 1922-08-01 shows a lookout cabin under construction on the peak; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date a log cupola cabin to 1930. The story reports both and does not pick one.
The record and the FFLA list spell it Nezperce Peak; the sources spell it Nez Perce Peak. Same summit.

notes_for_editor: Fate is consistent (destroyed 1950). Build date conflicts: 1922 photo (cabin under construction) vs 1930 log cupola cabin (two sites). Not reconciled. The 1923 Missoulian item about a 'Nez Perce lookout station on the West Fork' was left out; it may be a different station. The Forest Service Nez Perce NF list does not include this peak. Record location 45.7316,-114.58575 is about 1.5 km from the photo's coordinates (45.720083,-114.595227); not proposed as a correction. The UI photo is public domain per its record, so it could be a photo for the record once the image URL is confirmed. No source describes the summit today.
